title: Design note: peer-cap refresh starvation at MAX_PEERS/MAX_RECEIVED_ROUTE_PEERS=64 (parity-matched both impls)
description: Existing entries refreshable forever, no TTL/LRU: 64 compromised-but-authenticated gateways permanently block new legit ones. Mirrored in Rust by design. Option: idle-timeout eviction. Record decision; do not silently change semantics without cross-impl coordination.
